# Catalog index

Every screen type, library screen, component, action and transition of the PQ1 wallet UI. Tags: **PORT** implement on the device · **DEMO-ONLY** / **BENCH-ONLY** do not port · **SPEC-ONLY** specified, not rendered by the Python yet.

## Screen types

Every kind of screen a flow can contain.

| page | what it is | port |
|---|---|---|
| [Hero — the ask](screen-types/hero-ask.md) | The question the flow exists to ask (SEND 12,500 TOSHI?). The hub: taps enter the details, hold-right signs. | PORT |
| [Hero — an intro (band chevron)](screen-types/hero-intro.md) | A hero that introduces instead of asking: the caption carries the chevron, corners hide, nothing to sign here. | PORT |
| [Hero — batch position (n/m pager)](screen-types/hero-pager.md) | A batch's per-transaction hero: the pager says which transaction of how many; it never turns. | PORT |
| [Detail](screen-types/detail.md) | One fact of the transaction: circle + label on one side, 1–3 value lines on the other. Sides alternate. | PORT |
| [Chain badge](screen-types/chain.md) | Which network is being signed for: one chain id becomes the mark, the disc colour, the trail and the caption. | PORT |
| [Detail — paged (n/m)](screen-types/detail-paged.md) | A value too long for three lines: pages of 1–3 lines, a pager, and taps that turn the page before the screen. | PORT |
| [Value — full-width text](screen-types/value.md) | A value shown alone and centred across the panel; the token disc parks off-canvas. | PORT |
| [Value — paged](screen-types/value-paged.md) | A full-width value over two or more pages (a full hash), with the n/m pager. | PORT |
| [Value — numbered words grid](screen-types/value-words.md) | Up to eight numbered words in two columns (the firmware fingerprint words). | PORT |
| [Confirm? — the mid-flow early exit](screen-types/confirm.md) | Inserted automatically as the 6th screen of a long flow: sign now, or keep reading. | PORT |
| [Batch — a run of segments](screen-types/batch-segment.md) | A batch is several transactions in one flow: each segment has its own hub hero and its own ending. | PORT |
| [Status — the qubit film (an ending after work)](screen-types/status-qubit.md) | The device did work: the token splits into two qubits, orbits — on the device for as long as the work takes — spirals back, flashes, and the result lands: the check, or the X when the host reports a failure. | PORT |
| [Status — the resolve (a cancel ending)](screen-types/status-resolve.md) | A cancel does no work, so there is no film: the token resolves in place to the failed look. | PORT |
| [Status — arrive (an ending after a lead film)](screen-types/status-arrive.md) | The resting look arrives on an empty canvas under the verdict entrance law. | PORT |
| [Status — led by a film (lead + gap + main)](screen-types/status-led.md) | One screen made of two animations: a film that ends on an empty canvas, a gap of black, then the main. | PORT |
| [The resting look — branded vs unbranded endings](screen-types/resting-look.md) | What an ending rests on: unbranded flows stroke the disc in the state colour; branded families fill it. | PORT |

## Components

The parts screens are made of.

| page | what it is | port |
|---|---|---|
| [Token disc](components/token-disc.md) | The 60 px circle every navigable screen carries: solid, unknown (address-hashed ramp), logo art or monogram. | PORT |
| [Glyph + chevron morph](components/glyph-morph.md) | Between two screens the glyph inside the disc and the corner chevrons crossfade on the mix spring. | PORT |
| [Corner chevrons and the hint bob](components/chevrons.md) | The two corner marks say what the buttons do: lr = taps navigate, up = a hold is armed. They bob to hint. | PORT |
| [Band chevron](components/band-chevron.md) | An intro's caption carries one chevron beside the text; the corner chevrons hide. | PORT |
| [Pager (n/m)](components/pager.md) | The small n/m mark: on a paged value it follows the page; on a batch hero it names the transaction. | PORT |
| [Confirm band](components/confirm-band.md) | The Confirm? screen's bottom band alternates two instructions on a slow beat. | PORT |
| [Caption (the bottom band)](components/caption.md) | The question / status text on the y-128 baseline, and how it fades between screens. | PORT |
| [Busy caption](components/busy-caption.md) | The caption during a loading film breathes; it starts only once the qubits are on the orbit. | PORT |
| [Detail text: label, tiers, name lines, transition rows](components/detail-text.md) | The value block: size tiers, the SemiBold name line, the old-to-new transition row, line stacking. | PORT |
| [Words grid](components/words-grid.md) | Two columns of four numbered words, numbers right-aligned in grey. | PORT |
| [Trail (follower chain)](components/trail.md) | Five discs trail the token as it travels and as it sweeps; each chases the one ahead. | PORT |
| [Idle sweep](components/idle-sweep.md) | On a hero the token drifts side to side after a short rest, inside fixed x bounds. | PORT |
| [Pulse rings](components/pulse-rings.md) | Expanding rings around the disc that mark a screen needing extra attention (blind signing). | PORT |
| [Flash ring + result glyphs](components/flash-ring.md) | How a result lands on the disc: the flash ring, the check / X glyph and the caption. | PORT |
| [Hold flood (the progress fill)](components/hold-flood.md) | A hold fills the disc from the bottom up; three dresses depending on the body under it. | PORT |
| [PIN row: slots, dials, marks and labels](components/pin-row.md) | Eight rings; the active one dials a digit; − / + marks and pulsing instruction labels. | PORT |
| [Press feedback (chevron nudge)](components/press-feedback.md) | The pressed side's chevron nudges for an instant. Specified, not yet rendered by the Python. | SPEC-ONLY |

## Actions

What the two buttons do, in every context.

| page | what it is | port |
|---|---|---|
| [Tap on the ask — enter the details](actions/tap-hub.md) | Either tap on a hero enters the detail section at its first screen; an intro leads on to the ask. | PORT |
| [Tap left / right — back and forward](actions/tap-navigate.md) | Inside the details left regresses, right progresses; a paged screen turns its page first. | PORT |
| [Tap on a paged screen — the page turns first](actions/tap-page.md) | Right: next page until the last, then the next screen. Left: previous page, then the previous screen on its LAST page. | PORT |
| [Hold right — sign](actions/hold-right-sign.md) | Armed only where the screen commits (the ask, Confirm?). The disc fills; the action fires when it is full. | PORT |
| [Hold left — decline](actions/hold-left-decline.md) | Armed on every navigable screen of a flow that has a failing ending. | PORT |
| [Release a hold early — snap back](actions/hold-release-early.md) | Letting go before the fill completes drains it and does nothing. | PORT |
| [Unbound gestures — what is NOT bound](actions/unbound-gestures.md) | Right hold where nothing commits, both buttons and double presses outside an entry, any input during an ending. | PORT |
| [PIN entry — tap to dial the digit](actions/entry-dial.md) | On an entry a tap is −1 / +1 on the active dial. | PORT |
| [PIN entry — both buttons ENTER; the 8th checks the PIN](actions/entry-enter.md) | The chord enters the digit and moves on; the chord that completes the row submits it at once. | PORT |
| [PIN entry — double press: BACK / NEXT over entered digits](actions/entry-move.md) | A second press on one side inside the double-tap window moves the cursor; a dial is never taken away. | PORT |
| [PIN entry — hold left cancels the row](actions/entry-cancel.md) | Only the left hold is bound on an entry: the rings fill white and the row is cancelled. | PORT |
| [PIN entry — after the row: miss, match, cancel](actions/entry-outcome.md) | A miss plays its verdict and opens the next attempt; a match continues; a cancel returns. | PORT |
| [Demo auto-advance and the demo-performed hold](actions/demo-auto-advance.md) | The GIF / kiosk loop advances on dwell timers and performs the hold itself. On hardware nothing moves without a press. | DEMO-ONLY |
| [Bench player keys](actions/bench-keys.md) | The laptop bench player maps keyboard keys onto the two buttons to drive the panel. | BENCH-ONLY |

## Transitions

How the UI moves between and inside screens.

| page | what it is | port |
|---|---|---|
| [Spring morph — screen to screen](transitions/spring-morph.md) | Every screen change is one critically-damped spring set: circle x / y / r, the glyph mix and each screen's text alpha. | PORT |
| [Mid-flight reversal and retargeting](transitions/reversal.md) | A press during a transit is never dropped: the springs retarget from the live pose, velocity carried. | PORT |
| [Text-in delay — the circle leads](transitions/text-in-delay.md) | Outgoing text fades at once; incoming text is released a beat later, so the disc visibly leads the words. | PORT |
| [Page flip](transitions/page-flip.md) | A page change is sequential: the old page fades out, then the new one fades in. The pager follows. | PORT |
| [Handoff crossfade — token to verdict](transitions/handoff.md) | Entering a screen that owns its canvas, the flow's resting token fades out under the screen's hold phase. | PORT |
| [Token-less transit — fade to black](transitions/tokenless-fade.md) | Leaving a verdict or a PIN row nothing morphs: the screen fades to black and the next handoff is dropped. | PORT |
| [Lead film, tail and gap](transitions/lead-film.md) | A film that ends on an empty canvas may lead a screen: its tail keeps drawing under the main's hold. A looping lead carries the led screen's start with it. | PORT |
| [Entering a film — the beat, then the seed](transitions/film-entrance.md) | The one sequential transit: the screen fades out with its circle parked, then the film morphs that circle into its first qubit. No spring leg. | PORT |
| [The loading loop and the outcome latch](transitions/loading-loop.md) | A film starts when the work is dispatched, repeats the steady orbit in whole turns while the answer is outstanding, and latches its outcome at the spiral — the tail and the rest are fixed. | PORT |
| [Side entrance of a film](transitions/side-entrance.md) | The explosion's token can enter from off-panel (left / right / both sides) before the film starts. | PORT |
| [Hold commit — the fill fades with the leg](transitions/hold-commit-fade.md) | When a hold fires, the full fill does not pop: it fades out riding the transit's own spring. | PORT |
| [The verdict law — hold, arrive, beat, caption, rest](transitions/verdict-law.md) | The phase law every verdict and arriving status obeys, and the entrance law inside it. | PORT |
| [Result hold and leaving an ending](transitions/result-hold.md) | Every ending rests for the same time after it resolves, then the flow returns. | PORT |
